purpose: Define the motion rules of the Below Basin so future cases are routed by observable conditions instead of aesthetic intuition.

state_variables.question: How public/hidden is the relevant information?
How well supported is the claim?
How strongly does the relation reproduce itself over time?
Does persistence depend on harvesting attention, money, status, labor or vulnerability?
Can false claims, stale labels or changed states be revised?
Can people leave or disengage without disproportionate penalty?
How much source lineage must be recovered to understand the present claim?

motion_rules.when: A question depends materially on hidden provenance, restricted information, accumulated residue, clandestine coordination, coercive reproduction or investigative repair.
motion_rules.note: The entity itself has not become morally lower; the active research question has become below-facing.

motion_rules.when: Recurring participants + shared language/lore + recognizable roles + durable memory + meaningful boundary.
motion_rules.note: Size is not decisive; reproduction is.

motion_rules.when: Observation/capture/interpretation/archive/redistribution forms a repeatable loop around a person/event/category.
motion_rules.movement: Sektur or culture surface -> Farm loop
motion_rules.note: Farm is a process crossing regions, not a territory.

motion_rules.when: Old allegations, labels, clips, sanctions or unresolved events remain available but are no longer cleanly attached to current provenance/status.
motion_rules.note: Mud can contain truth, falsehood and mixed residue; it is not a synonym for misinformation.

motion_rules.when: A rupture destroys a prior relation/institution/identity and leaves unresolved remains.
motion_rules.note: Ash is post-rupture residue and can later move toward Mud/Strife or Soil/Life.

motion_rules.when: High recurrence + low correctability + opacity/jurisdictional fragmentation + role-lock + unresolved residue reinforce one another.
motion_rules.note: Swamp is diagnosed from conditions, not assigned because an actor is disliked.

motion_rules.when: A claim has enough identifiable source material to test, or harm/risk requires bounded review.
motion_rules.note: Dramatic material without recoverable provenance may remain unresolved instead of being promoted.

motion_rules.when: Source recovery, counterevidence or legal/status review fails the claim.
motion_rules.note: Rejection remains archived with provenance so failed claims do not silently resurrect.

motion_rules.when: Evidence supports only a narrower proposition than the circulating narrative.
motion_rules.note: This is one of the most important anti-Swamp functions: reduce an oversized story to what is actually established.

motion_rules.when: Record clarity + responsibility/boundary + reduced recurrence + changed incentives or restored capacity.
motion_rules.note: Repair does not require reconciliation; legitimate separation can be a successful output.

motion_rules.when: A claim/status/model is sufficiently sourced and scoped for public use.
motion_rules.note: Return should preserve date, provenance and uncertainty.

motion_rules.when: Material leaves Forge unresolved or never reaches it and continues to generate reactions.
motion_rules.note: This is the core Strife loop.

qualitative_equations.swamp_pressure: recurrence + opacity + extraction + role_lock + unresolved_residue - correction - exit - repair
qualitative_equations.mud_accumulation: unresolved_input + archive_reactivation + stale_labels + rupture_residue - correction - resolution - healthy_forgetting
qualitative_equations.repair_gain: record_clarity + safety + accountability + incentive_change + future_capacity - coercion - false_balance - identity_lock

design_rules: No node gets a permanent moral color merely because it is placed Below.
Use motion/flow animation for processes and texture/depth for states; do not use the same visual encoding for both.
Swamp should appear as an environmental overlay, not a named actor node.
Mud/Ash should accumulate visually under nodes rather than replace them.
Forge outputs should visibly branch into verified, narrowed, rejected, repaired and unresolved states.
Every interactive case should expose why it moved between zones.
